item.ExperimentalTi-alloydrilldsc: A titanium-alloy upgrade of the heavy drill. The bit is self-heating for higher efficiency.
item.Experimentalplasmaemitterdsc: The plasma flow limiter has been removed, and the cooling system has been rebuilt with titanium alloy so that more plasma beams can be fired in the same amount of time.
item.Experimentalspeciallegpackdsc: An expanded upgrade of the special leg pack, fitted with experimental electronic components that provide protection when it matters.
item.Autoreloadingammobeltdsc: An advanced experimental ammo belt: its capacity has been expanded, and it can automatically reload the magazines inside.
